examples.english: I'm home (now).
examples.translation: I'm home (now).

examples.english: I see (now).
examples.translation: I see (now).

examples.english: I understand (now).
examples.translation: I understand (now).

examples.english: I don't know anymore.
examples.translation: I don't know anymore.

examples.english: Person A and B: Oh no! We got lost! Whatever will we do!? Person B: Oh I know (now)! We will live in the forest and eat poisonous mushrooms.
examples.text: Person A and B: ¡Oh no! ¡Nos hemos perdido! ¿¡Qué haremos ahora!? Person B: ¡Ya lo sé! Viviremos en el bosque y comeremos hongos venenosos.
examples.translation: Person A and B: Oh no! We got lost! Whatever will we do!? Person B: Oh I know (now)! We will live in the forest and eat poisonous mushrooms.

examples.text: Ya no quiero volver a ese lugar.

examples.text: Cuando le hablo ya ni me mira.
examples.translation: He doesn't even look at me now/anymore when I talk to him.

glosses: now, right now, (in the negative) anymore, no longer
